inspector.role: Ingests manufacturer manuals and warranty PDFs in a decoupled offline indexing pipeline preserving exact file and page metadata.
inspector.dataBoundary: Local document store; zero external upload required during indexing.
inspector.tradeoff: Decoupling indexing from chat runtime eliminates cold-start latency and guarantees deterministic chunk boundaries.
inspector.failureBehavior: Corrupt or unreadable pages are flagged during ingestion rather than silently dropping manual coverage.

inspector.role: Performs dense semantic retrieval returning top-k passages paired with mandatory document name and page number metadata.
inspector.dataBoundary: Local persistent vector database; predictable zero-token embedding cost.
inspector.tradeoff: Local embeddings trade slight peak recall on obscure phrasing for zero embedding API cost and offline reproducibility.
inspector.failureBehavior: When similarity scores drop below threshold, retrieval returns an empty verified set to trigger explicit refusal.

inspector.role: Synthesizes troubleshooting and warranty guidance strictly from retrieved manual passages with inline source/page citations.
inspector.dataBoundary: Context window restricted strictly to retrieved chunks + conversation state.
inspector.tradeoff: Strict tool-call contract prevents free-form speculation on electrical safety or warranty eligibility.
inspector.failureBehavior: Refuses unsupported answers explicitly instead of fabricating warranty clauses.

inspector.role: Validates every tool payload and final answer structure to verify that cited file names and page numbers match retrieved context.
inspector.dataBoundary: Pure deterministic Python validation layer backed by automated pytest checks.
inspector.tradeoff: Adds strict schema maintenance overhead when adding tools, but catches citation drift before it reaches users.
inspector.failureBehavior: Rejects ungrounded outputs and forces a safe 'not found in manual' response.

inspector.role: Presents answers alongside expandable source/page evidence cards for fast human verification.
inspector.dataBoundary: Stateless session rendering validated response objects.
inspector.tradeoff: Streamlit minimized frontend boilerplate so engineering effort stayed focused on retrieval precision and automated tests.
inspector.failureBehavior: Displays clear refusal guidance and suggests supported appliance models when coverage is absent.

nominal.label: Nominal Flow
nominal.description: Manual query retrieves page-indexed passages from ChromaDB, passes Pydantic citation verification, and renders verified answers.

guardrail.label: Guardrail / No-Evidence Refusal
guardrail.description: When no passage meets retrieval confidence or a citation fails Pydantic validation, the system outputs an explicit refusal instead of hallucinating.
